faqs.q: Should I choose aluminum or copper gutters for my West Orange home?

faqs.q: Do clogged gutters cause ice dams on West Orange roofs?

runs.v: Clogged gutters aggravate eave ice but do not cause an ice dam; the root cause is attic heat that melts the snowpack and refreezes at the cold eave, per University of Minnesota Extension. An ice barrier from the eave to at least 24 inches inside the exterior wall line protects the edge, per IRC Section R905.1.2.
